evidence: Advisory describes a protocol-level DoS (TuDoor) affecting DNS resolution timing/validation shared between eventlet and dnspython, but names no specific function or method in either codebase.
assumptions: The flaw plausibly lives in dnspython's UDP query handling (e.g. dns.query.udp / dns.query.receive_udp) or in dns.resolver.Resolver.resolve's retry/timeout loop, but this is not stated in the advisory.
The root cause may actually reside in the eventlet package's socket/DNS code rather than in dnspython itself, since dnspython is described only as 'used' alongside eventlet.
Any dnspython module path (dns.query, dns.resolver) would be inferred from general package knowledge, not from the advisory text.
